topics.topic: Ngwaa na Ụdị Ya: Ngwaa mfe, ngwaa ndụkọta na ngwaa nkwado
learningObjectives: Ịkọwa ihe bụ ngwaa n'usoro ụtọasụsụ Igbo
Ịmata ọdịiche dị n'etiti ngwaa mfe na ngwaa ndụkọta
Ide ahịrịokwu ndị na-egosipụta ụdị ngwaa dị iche iche

topics.topic: Nkebiokwu Aha na Ọrụ Ya n'Ahịrịokwu
learningObjectives: Ịkọwa ihe bụ nkebiokwu aha na ngalaba ya
Ịmata ọrụ nkebiokwu aha na-arụ dị ka isiokwu ma ọ bụ ngwụcha okwu
Ịchọpụta nkebiokwu aha n'ime ahịrịokwu dị mgbagwoju anya

topics.topic: Omenaala Ịgụ Aha na Emume Ibe Ugwu n'Ala Igbo
learningObjectives: Ịkọwa usoro na emume dị na igba igu aha n'omenala Igbo
Ịmata ihe mere ndị Igbo ji ebe ugwu n'oge ochie na uru ahụike ya
Ịkọwa ihe akara aha dị iche iche pụtara n'ezinụlọ Igbo

topics.topic: Agụmagụ Ederede: Akwụkwọ ejije na agwa ndị nọ n'ime ya
learningObjectives: Ịgụ ejije Igbo a họpụtara nke ọma na klas
Ịkọwa isiokwu na esemokwu dị n'ejije ahụ
Inyocha omume na agwa ndị mere ejije ahụ nwee mmasị

topics.topic: Edemede Leta Ezinụlọ (Leta nke na-abụghị nke akaọrụ)
learningObjectives: Ịmata ngalaba ise dị na leta ezinụlọ (adreesị, ụbọchị, ekele mbido, isi okwu, ngwụcha)
Iji asụsụ enyi na enyi na-ede leta nye nwanne ma ọ bụ nne na nna
Igosipụta nka ederede Igbo doro anya

topics.topic: Emume Iri Ji Ọhụrụ (Iwa Ji / Iri Ji) n'Ala Igbo
learningObjectives: Ịkọwa mkpa emume iri ji ọhụrụ dị n'ala Igbo
Ịkọwapụta usoro e si eme emume ahụ site n'obodo gaa n'obodo
Ịmata arụsị na ngwa dị mkpa e ji ekele Chi maka ezi owuwe ihe ubi

topics.topic: Nlele Nnwale Nke Etiti Oge na Nleba Anya n'Iwu Ụtọasụsụ
learningObjectives: Inyocha nghọta ụmụakwụkwọ na ngwaa na nkebiokwu
Inyocha leta ezinụlọ ha dere iji dozie nsụpe okwu
Inye nkwado maka ụmụakwụkwọ na-adọga n'asụsụ

topics.topic: Nkowaha na Nkowangwaa: Ọrụ ha na nkwalite ahịrịokwu
learningObjectives: Ịkọwa ihe bụ nkọwaha na nkọwangwaa n'Igbo
Iji nkọwaha kọwaa ụdị, agba, na nha ihe
Iji nkọwangwaa gosi oge, ebe, na otu ihe siri mee

topics.topic: Abụ Ọdịnala na Abụ Ederede: Ụda, njikọ ahịrị, na echiche dị n'ime ha
learningObjectives: Ịgụ na ịgụnye abụ ọdịnala dịka abụ ọrụ, abụ nwa, na abụ agha
Inyocha asụsụ nka na mmetụta dị n'abụ ederede
Ịkọwa ozi dị mkpa odeabụ na-ebugara ọha mmadụ

topics.topic: Usoro Ikpe Ikpe na Ime Udo n'Ala Igbo Oge Gboo
learningObjectives: Ịkọwa ọrụ Ụmụnna, Ụmụada, na Ndị Ọzọ n'imezi esemokwu
Ịmata etu e si enye ntaramahụhụ maka mpụ dị iche iche dịka izu ohi
Ịkọwa mkpa ikpe ziri ezi na udo dị n'obodo

topics.topic: Iwu Nsụpe Okwu Ọgbara Ọhụrụ nke Asụsụ Igbo
learningObjectives: Ịmata iwu SPILC kwadoro maka nsụpe okwu Igbo
Ịmata mgbe a na-ejikọ okwu na mgbe a na-ekewa okwu
Ide okwu ndị sayensị na teknụzụ n'asụsụ Igbo ziri ezi

topics.topic: Nchịkọta Ọmụmụ Ihe na Nkwado Ule Ọgwụgwụ Oge
learningObjectives: Inyocha isiokwu niile a kụziri na tọm nke abụọ a
Idozi ajụjụ nlereanya nke ederede na nke agụmagụ
Ịkọwa ụkpụrụ na usoro e ji ede ule n'ụzọ ziri ezi

topics.topic: Ule Ọgwụgwụ Oge na Ntụle Akara na Broadsheet
learningObjectives: Inye ule ọnụ na nke ederede nye ụmụakwụkwọ niile
Iji nlezianya gbaa akara ule dịka ntuziaka steeti siri dị
Imeju akwụkwọ ndekọ akara maka nkwado ndị isi ụlọakwụkwọ
